patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column hero layout on the homepage, featuring a large lifestyle image on the left and a sticky, scrollable product display on the right.
Consistent use of a clean sans-serif typeface with varied weights for hierarchy, often employing uppercase for section titles and call-to-action labels.
High-contrast black and white base palette accented by a vibrant red/pink for interactive elements and key brand messaging.
The main navigation bar sticks to the top of the viewport, and a product display column on the homepage remains fixed on the right side as the user scrolls down the page.
A modal popup appears shortly after page load, prompting user engagement with a discount offer.
Feature sections are presented in a clean three-column grid with minimalist icons and concise descriptive text.

technique_notes: The primary navigation bar is implemented as a sticky header that remains visible at the top of the viewport after an initial scroll, ensuring constant access to site navigation.

A unique split-screen layout on the homepage utilizes a fixed-position container for product display on the right, which maintains visibility of key products while the main content area scrolls independently on the left.
Interactive elements like product image carousels are built using a slider library (swiper), allowing users to navigate through multiple product views with swipe gestures or navigation controls.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are significantly larger and bolder than body text, with uppercase used for emphasis in labels and CTAs.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and input fields, otherwise sharp edges on content blocks and images.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with ample whitespace around major content blocks, creating an airy feel, while product grids are more compact.

standout: The distinctive split-screen hero on the homepage, combining a large lifestyle image with a sticky, scrollable product display, effectively balances brand storytelling with immediate product visibility and purchase opportunity.
